import inspect,sys,asyncio,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts')
from telethon_sessions import inspect as auth_inspect,make_memory_client
from telethon.tl.functions.messages import (ExportChatInviteRequest,GetExportedChatInvitesRequest,GetChatInviteImportersRequest)
from telethon.tl.types import InputUserEmpty
for cls in (ExportChatInviteRequest,GetExportedChatInvitesRequest,GetChatInviteImportersRequest):
 print('METHOD_SIGNATURE',cls.__name__,str(inspect.signature(cls)),flush=True)
config=auth_inspect(__import__('pathlib').Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads'))
async def main():
 c=make_memory_client(config['entries'][0],config)
 try:
  await asyncio.wait_for(c.connect(),timeout=27)
  assert await asyncio.wait_for(c.is_user_authorized(),timeout=18)
  g=await asyncio.wait_for(c.get_entity(config['group']),timeout=19)
  resp=await asyncio.wait_for(c(GetChatInviteImportersRequest(peer=g,requested=True,offset_date=0,offset_user=InputUserEmpty(),limit=8)),timeout=25)
  users=getattr(resp,'users',None); importers=getattr(resp,'importers',None)
  print('PENDING_REQUEST_QUERY',json.dumps({'valid_shape':isinstance(users,(list,tuple)) and isinstance(importers,(list,tuple)),'count':len(importers) if isinstance(importers,(list,tuple)) else None,'target_group':config['group']},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
 finally:
  if c.is_connected():await c.disconnect()
asyncio.run(main())
print('READ_ONLY_REQUEST_API_PASS')
